title: What’s New: Financial Reporting (for Report Authors) (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Report definition editing - titles, descriptions, and formats
Copy, export and import of report definitions
Row definitions and the where used action

features.name: Internal description for report definitions
features.description: Report definitions now have an internal description field where authors can document their report definition for future reference.

features.name: Intro and closing paragraphs for reports
features.description: Authors can now add introductory and closing paragraphs to reports that will display when users run the report.

features.name: Negative amount format option
features.description: Authors can choose how negative amounts are displayed in reports - either as parentheses or with a minus sign.

features.name: Excel layouts for financial reports
features.description: Support for defining and exporting Excel layouts for financial reports, with ability to set a default layout for users to consume.

features.name: Copy, export and import report definitions
features.description: Ability to copy report definitions and use export/import functionality to manage report definitions.

features.name: Internal description for row definitions
features.description: Row definitions can now be documented with an internal description field.

features.name: Where used action for row and column definitions
features.description: A new where used action that shows which reports use a particular row or column definition, helping authors understand the impact of changes.
caveats: Available in both list and edit mode

features.name: Double underline option for rows
features.description: The double underline formatting option for rows is now visible and available for use in row definitions.
caveats: This feature existed previously but was hidden

features.name: Enhanced documentation for row definitions
features.description: New comprehensive documentation page for financial reporting row definitions covering formulas, formatting, empty lines, and conditional formatting.

features.name: Month-to-date column type
features.description: New column type option that allows authors to calculate and display month-to-date values in addition to the existing year-to-date functionality.

features.name: Documentation for column definitions
features.description: Help and documentation for working with column definitions in financial reporting.

quotes.text: Welcome to what's new and financial reporting for authors in uh the 2025 release wave one for Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the scope and version context for all features discussed in the video.

quotes.text: You can edit the introductory and closing paragraphs.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains a new capability for report authors to add contextual text content to reports.

quotes.text: there's also a new thing where we have support for Excel layouts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces a major new feature for Excel export and layout management in financial reports.

quotes.text: there's also uh something um a new thing here a new action called where used.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes a critical impact analysis tool that helps authors understand how changes affect multiple reports.

quotes.text: the double underline option is now not hidden anymore.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates that a previously available feature is now visible and accessible to report authors.

quotes.text: but now as a new thing in this wave we also added the monthto date.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms that the month-to-date column type is new in 2025 release wave 1.
